greeting: Good morning, Rick! Voyager 1 just crossed a record distance from home, so grab your coffee and enjoy the ride.

items.title: Voyager 1 Hits One Light-Day From Earth
items.note: Launched in 1977, NASA's Voyager 1 crossed one light-day from Earth early this morning, about 16.1 billion miles away. A radio signal now takes a full 24 hours to reach it, and it was only supposed to last about five years.

items.title: AirPods Pro 3 keep getting better, here's what's new in iOS 27
items.note: iOS 27 lets you set your own sound with a custom equalizer, and AirPods Pro 3 can now share your heart rate with GymKit treadmills, bikes, and ellipticals. A neat one for a PE guy.

items.title: Deals: Rare MacBook Neo discounts, Apple Watch Series 12, Nomad Black Friday sale
items.note: Early Black Friday deals are rolling in, with $70 off AirPods Pro 3, the best prices yet on Apple Watch Series 12, and Nomad's sale on iPhone cases and watch bands.

items.title: You can now see and edit what Google Gemini remembers about you
items.note: Google's Gemini assistant learns little facts about you from your chats. Now you can open its settings, see that list, and fix or delete anything you don't want it to remember.

items.title: Waymo is pausing all freeway rides after California DMV says the robotaxis are a hazard
items.note: California barred Waymo's driverless cars from freeways after one tried to pass a Highway Patrol car slowing traffic. Waymo has now paused freeway rides in every US city it serves.

items.title: SpaceX Misses Its Double Catch but Still Makes History by Catching the Starship
items.note: SpaceX tried to catch both halves of its giant rocket with the launch tower in Boca Chica, Texas. The booster ended up in the Gulf, but catching the Starship itself was a first.

items.title: GTA 6 Review: The Megayacht of Gaming Has Something for Nearly Everyone
items.note: The most hyped video game in years launches tomorrow, and CNET says it lives up to the hype with a huge, detailed world to explore.
